最稳妥、最接近官方支持的方案是：

```text
Windows VS Code
    │ Remote SSH
    ▼
Ubuntu 22.04 开发环境
    ├─ openvela 完整工作区
    ├─ GCC / GDB / OpenOCD
    └─ USB ST-LINK ── STM32H750B-DK
```

不要直接在 Windows、WSL 或 Docker 中构建。若使用 Ubuntu 虚拟机，需要把 ST-LINK USB 独占直通给虚拟机。

## 1. VS Code 的正确打开方式

Windows 安装：

- VS Code ≥ 1.99
- Remote - SSH

连接 Ubuntu 后，在“远程端”安装：

- C/C++
- Cortex-Debug
- `vela.vs-aiot-ide-vela`
- `vela.vela-preview`
- Serial Monitor，可选

VS Code 应打开完整工作区根目录：

```text
/home/<用户名>/openvela
```

不要只打开：

```text
openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons
```

因为本项目是通过 manifest 软链接接入 openvela：

```text
contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/app/*
        ↓
openvela/packages/demos/*

contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/board/*
        ↓
openvela/vendor/openvela/boards/*
```

开发时只修改参赛仓库内的源码，不要直接修改父级 `nuttx/`、`apps/`、`packages/`、`vendor/`。具体约束见 [README.md](/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/README.md:39)。

## 2. Ubuntu 安装编译和调试工具

```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y \
  lsb-release gcc-arm-none-eabi binutils-arm-none-eabi \
  gdb-multiarch openocd libusb-1.0-0-dev minicom
```

另外安装 Linux 版 STM32CubeProgrammer 及 ST-LINK udev rules。

插板后验证：

```bash
lsusb

openocd \
  -f board/stm32h750b-disco.cfg \
  -c init \
  -c "reset halt" \
  -c shutdown
```

目前我检查到这个开发环境已经有 ARM 编译器和 OpenOCD，但没有 `gdb-multiarch`，也尚未检测到已连接的 ST-LINK。

## 3. 编译

在 openvela 根目录运行：

```bash
cd /home/<用户名>/openvela
./build.sh stm32h750b-dk:lvgl -j8
```

不要照旧文档中的 `/build.sh` 绝对路径写法；本项目 README 中的根目录执行方式才是正确的。

产物：

```text
nuttx/nuttx       # 带符号的 ELF，供 GDB 使用
nuttx/nuttx.hex   # 推荐烧录文件
nuttx/nuttx.bin
```

当前基线只包含官方 `lvgldemo`，尚未创建可烧录的 VelaGuard 业务应用，见 [项目说明](/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/README.md:70)。

## 4. 打开调试符号

当前 `stm32h750b-dk:lvgl` 的 defconfig 没有启用 `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS`。首次配置后执行：

```bash
make -C nuttx menuconfig
```

在界面中按 `/` 搜索 `DEBUG_SYMBOLS`，启用：

```text
CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
```

然后增量编译：

```bash
make -C nuttx -j8
```

开发阶段可以保留该配置。以后项目自有 board config 完成后，再把它持久化到参赛仓库的 defconfig，不要提交对官方 `nuttx` board 的直接修改。

## 5. VS Code 一键编译、烧录

在本地开发环境的 `openvela/.vscode/tasks.json` 中配置；这是个人开发配置，不要提交到公共 openvela 仓库：

```json
{
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "label": "openvela: configure and build",
      "type": "shell",
      "command": "./build.sh stm32h750b-dk:lvgl -j8",
      "options": {
        "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}"
      },
      "problemMatcher": "$gcc",
      "group": "build"
    },
    {
      "label": "openvela: incremental build",
      "type": "shell",
      "command": "make -C nuttx -j8",
      "options": {
        "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}"
      },
      "problemMatcher": "$gcc"
    },
    {
      "label": "openvela: flash",
      "type": "shell",
      "command": "openocd -f board/stm32h750b-disco.cfg -c \"program nuttx/nuttx.hex verify reset exit\"",
      "options": {
        "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}"
      },
      "dependsOn": "openvela: incremental build",
      "problemMatcher": []
    }
  ]
}
```

使用方法：

- `Ctrl+Shift+B`：编译
- 命令面板 → `Tasks: Run Task` → `openvela: flash`：编译并烧录

也可以用官方 STM32CubeProgrammer CLI 烧录：

```bash
STM32_Programmer_CLI \
  -c port=SWD \
  -w nuttx/nuttx.hex \
  -v \
  -rst
```

## 6. VS Code 断点调试

创建 `openvela/.vscode/launch.json`：

```json
{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "configurations": [
    {
      "name": "STM32H750B-DK: OpenOCD Debug",
      "type": "cortex-debug",
      "request": "launch",
      "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}",
      "executable": "${workspaceFolder}/nuttx/nuttx",
      "servertype": "openocd",
      "gdbPath": "/usr/bin/gdb-multiarch",
      "searchDir": [
        "/usr/share/openocd/scripts"
      ],
      "configFiles": [
        "board/stm32h750b-disco.cfg"
      ],
      "runToEntryPoint": "nx_start",
      "preLaunchTask": "openvela: incremental build"
    }
  ]
}
```

然后：

1. 插入 STM32H750B-DK 的 ST-LINK USB。
2. 在源码中设置断点。
3. 按 `F5`。
4. VS Code 会编译、启动 OpenOCD、下载 ELF 并停在 `nx_start`。
5. 可查看变量、寄存器、内存和调用栈。

## 7. 串口日志

板载串口配置为 USART3，115200：

```bash
sudo minicom -D /dev/ttyACM0 -b 115200
```

关闭硬件和软件流控。也可以直接使用 VS Code Serial Monitor：

```text
端口：/dev/ttyACM0
波特率：115200
数据位：8
停止位：1
校验：None
流控：None
```

官方 STM32H750 编译、烧录和串口步骤也保存在 [STM32H750 指南](/home/debian19y/openvela/docs/zh-cn/quickstart/development_board/STM32H750.md:1)。

本轮只完成了只读调研，没有创建 Trellis 任务，也没有修改项目文件。
烧录用openocd好还是cube？

对这个 STM32H750B-DK 项目，建议两者都保留，日常以 OpenOCD 为主：

- 日常开发、VS Code 一键编译/烧录/断点调试：OpenOCD
- 首次验证、全片擦除、Option Bytes、烧录异常恢复：STM32CubeProgrammer

具体比较：

| 能力 | OpenOCD | CubeProgrammer |
|---|---|---|
| VS Code/Cortex-Debug 集成 | 很好 | 较弱 |
| 一键编译后烧录 | 很方便 | CLI 也可以 |
| GDB 断点调试 | 原生支持 | 需另配 ST-LINK GDB Server |
| 全片擦除/解除保护 | 一般 | 更可靠 |
| Option Bytes 配置 | 不够直观 | 最合适 |
| STM32 官方支持 | 社区工具 | ST 官方工具 |
| CI/脚本自动化 | 很好 | 可以，但安装更重 |

推荐工作流：

```text
平时按 F5 调试
    → OpenOCD + Cortex-Debug

普通固件下载
    → OpenOCD

OpenOCD 连接失败、芯片锁定、启动异常
    → CubeProgrammer 执行 Full Chip Erase
    → 检查 Option Bytes
    → 重新烧录 nuttx.hex
```

OpenOCD 日常烧录命令：

```bash
openocd \
  -f board/stm32h750b-disco.cfg \
  -c "program nuttx/nuttx.hex verify reset exit"
```

CubeProgrammer 恢复/正式烧录：

```bash
STM32_Programmer_CLI \
  -c port=SWD \
  -w nuttx/nuttx.hex \
  -v \
  -rst
```

结论：如果目标是“在 VS Code 里完成编译、下载、断点调试”，选 OpenOCD；CubeProgrammer 作为官方恢复工具和烧录兜底。无需为这个简单决策创建 Trellis 任务。

上一次我遇到一个问题：当我使用 OpenOCD 时，如果固件大小超过了开发板上的片上 Flash 大小，下载就会失败。

我用一个 AI Agent 尝试解决了很多次，但好像还是卡在了一个叫 QSPI 的问题上。后来，我用 Cube Programmer 修改了一点配置后就解决了。

我不知道这是那个 AI Agent 的能力问题，还是 OpenOCD 本就不支持这种状况下的烧录。

这很可能不是简单的“OpenOCD 支不支持”，而是三个环节混在了一起：链接地址、QSPI 初始化/外部 Flash loader、以及 STM32 的启动配置。你明确提到“上一次”，我会用 Trellis 的会话回溯能力找出当时 Cube Programmer 到底改了什么，再和当前 STM32H750B-DK 的链接脚本、OpenOCD QSPI 配置交叉核对。这个排查不需要创建 Trellis 任务，我先按只读分析处理。

text: 历史记录已经找到了关键失败现场：固件约 365 KB，而 STM32H750 片内 Flash 实际只有 128 KB；OpenOCD 正确探测到 128 KB，并在 `0x08020000` 报“无 flash bank”。此前 AI 曾用“伪造 2 MB 内部 Flash bank”的方式绕过去，这是错误修复——链接脚本也误写了 2 MB，导致工具被要求把不存在的片内空间当真。接下来只差确认 Cube Programmer 修改的是启动 Option Bytes，还是安装/选择了外部 Loader。

那基本可以确定：你在 CubeProgrammer 里选择了 External Loader（`.stldr`），所以它成功解决了“如何擦写板载 QSPI Flash”的问题。

这不是 OpenOCD 原理上完全不支持，而是 CubeProgrammer 在该场景下更成熟、更可靠。

### 实际发生了什么

STM32H750XBH6 的片内 Flash 只有 128 KB：

```text
片内 Flash：0x08000000 ～ 0x0801FFFF
外部 QSPI：通常映射到 0x90000000
```

当约 365 KB 的固件仍链接到 `0x08000000` 时，OpenOCD 正确报告：

```text
flash size probed value 128k
no flash bank found for address 0x08020000
```

这不是 OpenOCD 的缺陷，而是镜像地址与硬件容量不匹配。此前 AI 通过手工声明“2 MB 片内 Flash bank”绕过检查，是错误做法，因为物理上不存在那 2 MB。

### External Loader 为什么能解决

CubeProgrammer 的 External Loader 是专门针对具体开发板和外部 Flash 编写的烧录算法。它会在目标 MCU 上临时运行一小段程序，负责：

- 初始化时钟和 GPIO；
- 配置 QSPI 控制器；
- 识别外部 NOR Flash；
- 处理 QPI/SPI 模式切换；
- 擦除扇区；
- 写入并校验 `0x90000000` 区域。

而 OpenOCD 使用的是：

```text
board/stm32h750b-disco.cfg
    └─ qspi_init
    └─ stmqspi flash driver
```

历史记录显示，OpenOCD 虽然创建出了 `0x90000000` 的 QSPI bank，也能读取该地址，但在 `flash probe` 和写入时发生了：

```text
timeout
flash probe 1 timeout
Assertion failed: run_size > 0
```

这说明当时遇到的是 OpenOCD 的 QSPI 驱动、初始化脚本、xPack 版本或 Flash 当前模式之间的兼容问题，不是 OpenOCD 完全不具备 QSPI 能力。

### 对之前 AI Agent 的判断

可以分成两部分：

- 判断固件超过 128 KB，需要使用 QSPI：正确。
- 设计“片内 boot stub + 外部 QSPI 主镜像”：方向正确。
- 把片内 Flash 强行声明成 2 MB：错误。
- 没及时切换到 Cube External Loader 做交叉验证：排障策略不够好。
- OpenOCD 最终卡在 QSPI probe：也确实存在工具链兼容问题，不全是 Agent 能力问题。

### 最推荐的开发链

对这块 STM32H750B-DK，建议采用混合方案：

```text
片内 boot stub
    → OpenOCD 或 CubeProgrammer 均可烧录

QSPI 主固件
    → CubeProgrammer External Loader 烧录

断点调试
    → OpenOCD + GDB/Cortex-Debug
```

也就是说：

- CubeProgrammer 负责可靠烧录 QSPI；
- OpenOCD 继续负责 VS Code 断点调试；
- 不必强求 OpenOCD 同时承担 QSPI 烧录。

需要注意，External Loader 只负责“把数据写进 QSPI”，并不会自动修复启动链。最终镜像仍需满足：

1. 主镜像链接地址在 `0x90000000`；
2. 片内 128 KB 中存在正确的 boot stub，或者芯片启动配置能够进入 QSPI；
3. 跳转前已经配置 QSPI memory-mapped 模式、向量表、MPU和Cache。

因此，你当时用 CubeProgrammer 解决问题，很可能是前面的 QSPI 镜像和 boot stub 已经基本正确，只剩 OpenOCD 写不进去；External Loader 恰好补上了最后一环。
事实上 我不确定当时的解决方案是External Loader

明白，那我前面的判断过于确定，应当撤回。你选择的是“最可能的选项”，不能证明当时确实用了 External Loader。

目前只能确认：

- 固件约 365 KB，超过片内 128 KB；
- OpenOCD 在 `0x08020000` 失败是合理的；
- 当时 OpenOCD 的 QSPI 写入又出现过 `flash probe timeout`；
- CubeProgrammer 修改某项配置后成功；
- 但现有可检索记录没有保存具体修改项，相关 OpenCode 历史目前也无法被 Trellis 读取。

CubeProgrammer 中可能解决问题的操作主要有三种：

1. 选择 External Loader，把镜像写到 `0x90000000`。
2. 修改 Option Bytes，例如启动地址 `BOOT_ADD0`。
3. 仅执行 Full Chip Erase、解除保护或改变复位连接模式，使原本的片内烧录恢复。

其中第 3 种不能让 365 KB 固件装进物理 128 KB Flash；如果完整固件最终确实运行起来，那么必然还涉及外部存储、分段镜像，或实际烧录的固件并不是那个 365 KB 镜像。

最可靠的确认方法是重新连接开发板，在 CubeProgrammer 中只读检查：

- External Loader 页面是否选择过对应的 `.stldr`；
- Option Bytes 中 `BOOT_ADD0/BOOT_ADD1` 当前值；
- `0x08000000` 片内 Flash 内容；
- `0x90000000` QSPI 区域是否存在有效向量表或镜像头；
- 当时烧录日志是否出现 `External Loader`、`0x90000000` 或 loader 文件名。

所以现阶段准确结论是：OpenOCD并非原则上不支持 QSPI，但当时的失败既包含错误的片内链接布局，也可能包含 OpenOCD QSPI 驱动兼容问题；CubeProgrammer究竟通过哪条路径解决，尚不能从现有证据确定。

# STM32H750B-DK 稳定开发与烧录方案

## 总结

采用混合工具链，暂时不要继续强行解决 OpenOCD 的 QSPI 烧录问题：

- Linux/WSL：编译 openvela
- CubeProgrammer CLI：烧录片内 Flash 和外部 QSPI
- OpenOCD + Cortex-Debug：VS Code 断点调试
- VS Code Task：串联编译、烧录和调试

## 实施步骤

1. 先确认镜像布局

   - 用 `arm-none-eabi-size`、`readelf -l`、`objdump -h` 检查 `nuttx`。
   - STM32H750 片内有效范围只能是 `0x08000000–0x0801ffff`。
   - 如果 HEX 在 `0x08020000` 后还有内容，禁止继续按片内 Flash 烧录。
   - 主镜像超过 128 KB 时，必须改为外部 QSPI 布局，不能伪造 2 MB 内部 Flash。

2. 固定两阶段启动结构

   - 片内 `0x08000000`：只放小型 boot stub，大小不得超过 128 KB。
   - 外部 `0x90000000`：放主 openvela/NuttX 镜像。
   - boot stub 初始化时钟、QSPI memory-mapped 模式、MPU、Cache 和向量表，然后跳转到主镜像入口。
   - 不依赖未知的 CubeProgrammer Option Bytes 状态直接启动 QSPI。

3. 用 CubeProgrammer 建立已知基线

   - 修改前保存当前 Option Bytes 截图或导出记录。
   - 找到与 STM32H750B-DK 板载 QSPI 型号匹配的 External Loader。
   - 用该 loader 烧录并校验 `0x90000000` 的主镜像。
   - 再烧录并校验 `0x08000000` 的 boot stub。
   - 断电重启，确认系统能够独立启动。
   - 把成功的 CubeProgrammer GUI 日志保存下来，据此生成等效 CLI 命令，避免继续猜测当时修改过什么。

4. 集成到 VS Code

   - `Build` Task：在 Linux/WSL 中构建 boot stub 和 QSPI 主镜像。
   - `Flash` Task：调用 Windows `STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe`，分别烧录 QSPI 主镜像和片内 boot stub。
   - `Debug` 配置：OpenOCD 只启动 GDB Server，不自动重新烧录。
   - Cortex-Debug 加载 QSPI 主镜像 ELF 的符号，然后 attach 到运行中的目标。
   - 每次代码变化执行“Build → Cube CLI Flash → OpenOCD Debug”。

5. OpenOCD QSPI 作为后续优化

   - 主流程稳定后，单独验证 OpenOCD 的 `stmqspi` bank。
   - 依次验证 `flash banks`、`flash probe`、小文件擦写、完整镜像写入。
   - 只有完整写入和校验连续通过后，才允许用 OpenOCD 替代 CubeProgrammer。
   - 不再使用手工声明 2 MB 片内 Flash 的绕过命令。

## 验收测试

- boot stub 完全位于片内 128 KB 范围。
- 主镜像的代码段位于 `0x90000000`。
- CubeProgrammer 对两段镜像均显示写入和校验成功。
- 完全断电再上电后，openvela 能正常启动。
- VS Code 可在 QSPI 主镜像源码中命中断点、查看变量和调用栈。
- 烧录失败时不会覆盖错误地址，并明确区分片内 Flash 与 QSPI 错误。

## 假设与默认选择

- 默认采用“片内 boot stub + QSPI XIP 主镜像”。
- 默认使用 CubeProgrammer 烧录、OpenOCD 调试。
- 不根据无法确认的历史操作修改 Option Bytes。
- External Loader 的具体文件以当前 CubeProgrammer 安装中与开发板及 Flash 型号匹配的 loader 为准。

 # Stable STM32H750 QSPI flash and debug workflow
 
 ## Goal
 
-TBD.
+Provide a reproducible Windows VSCode workflow for building openvela in WSL,
+programming an STM32H750B-DK whose firmware exceeds the 128 KiB on-die Flash,
+and debugging the resulting QSPI-XIP image without relying on OpenOCD to write
+the external NOR.
+
+## Background
+
+- STM32H750XBH6 has 128 KiB of on-die Flash at
+  `0x08000000..0x0801ffff`; the board's stock `flash.ld` incorrectly exposes
+  2 MiB for the non-M4 build.
+- A previous 365 KiB image failed in OpenOCD at `0x08020000`, which is the
+  first byte beyond physical internal Flash.
+- Historical commit `5eb5070` records hardware validation that xPack OpenOCD
+  `stmqspi` could not JEDEC-probe/write the board's dual MT25TL01G, while
+  CubeProgrammer's `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr` External Loader worked.
+- The current clean-restart branch intentionally has no VelaGuard business
+  application yet. The workflow must therefore build the stock
+  `stm32h750b-dk:lvgl` target now and remain usable when a team-owned app is
+  added later.
 
 ## Requirements
 
-- TBD
+- R1: Keep all maintained project changes inside this contest repository;
+  represent required upstream NuttX changes as an idempotent patch applied by
+  the build script.
+- R2: Build a minimal internal-Flash boot stub at `0x08000000` and reject it
+  if it exceeds the physical 128 KiB range.
+- R3: Link the main NuttX image into the external QSPI XIP window beginning at
+  `0x90000000`; reject images outside the configured QSPI range before any
+  programming command runs.
+- R4: Use Windows STM32CubeProgrammer CLI plus the board-specific External
+  Loader to program and verify the QSPI image, then program and verify the
+  internal boot stub.
+- R5: Use Windows OpenOCD only as the Cortex-Debug GDB server; debugging must
+  attach with symbols and must not implicitly rewrite QSPI.
+- R6: Provide VSCode tasks for build, release flash, debug flash, flash-only,
+  and attach-debug flows when the repository is opened through its Windows
+  WSL UNC path.
+- R7: Tool paths, WSL distribution, openvela root, output directory, and
+  External Loader path must be overridable instead of requiring source edits.
+- R8: Preserve the current source tree and existing user changes; do not
+  restore the deleted historical VelaGuard application or modify unrelated
+  parent repositories.
+- R9: Document the tool boundary, artifact addresses, setup, recovery path,
+  and diagnostics in Chinese.

+# Design: STM32H750 QSPI flash and debug workflow
+
+## Architecture
+
+The build produces two independently validated images. A freestanding boot
+stub occupies the real 128 KiB internal Flash window and initializes the board
+QSPI controller in the hardware-validated SPI memory-mapped mode before
+jumping through the vector table at `0x90000000`. NuttX is linked as an XIP
+image at `0x90000000`; its writable data retains SRAM VMAs with QSPI load
+addresses.
+
+The team repository owns a patch that adds a QSPI Kconfig switch, linker
+script selection for Make/CMake, and an executable MPU mapping to upstream
+NuttX. A guarded patch helper applies it to the exact clean baseline. This
+keeps the public NuttX checkout free of hand-maintained edits while allowing
+the complete workspace build to consume the support.
+
+## Tool Boundaries and Data Flow
+
+1. Windows VSCode invokes a PowerShell build wrapper.
+2. The wrapper invokes WSL, applies the NuttX patch, configures
+   `stm32h750b-dk:lvgl`, enables QSPI boot and optional debug symbols, builds
+   NuttX, builds the boot stub, and copies artifacts to a Windows directory.
+3. The flash wrapper parses both Intel HEX files before accessing hardware.
+4. CubeProgrammer loads `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr`, writes/verifies the
+   main HEX in external QSPI, disconnects, writes/verifies the boot stub in
+   internal Flash, and resets.
+5. Cortex-Debug starts OpenOCD as a debug server and attaches GDB using the
+   QSPI ELF solely as a symbol file. The debug configuration suppresses target
+   download so CubeProgrammer remains the only programming authority.
+
+## Interfaces
+
+- `scripts/windows_build_openvela.ps1`: parameters for WSL distro, openvela
+  root, board config, output directory, and debug build; QSPI is the safe
+  default for this board.
+- `scripts/windows_flash_cube.ps1`: parameters for Cube CLI, External Loader,
+  artifact directory, optional build, and debug build.
+- `scripts/apply-openvela-qspi-patch.sh`: idempotent patch application with a
+  clean/already-applied/error result.
+- `.vscode/tasks.json` and `.vscode/launch.json`: user-facing build/flash and
+  attach-debug entries; machine-specific paths are supplied through
+  environment variables with historical paths as backward-compatible
+  defaults.
+
+## Failure Handling and Safety
+
+- Address-range validation happens before CubeProgrammer is launched.
+- The main image may not overlap internal Flash; the stub may not extend past
+  `0x0801ffff`.
+- Each CubeProgrammer step checks its exit status; the stub and reset are not
+  attempted after a failed QSPI write.
+- No script changes Option Bytes, performs a mass erase by default, or lies to
+  OpenOCD about internal Flash size.
+- The old OpenOCD flash entry becomes an explicit diagnostic/compatibility
+  wrapper that redirects to CubeProgrammer or clearly refuses QSPI writes.
+
+## Compatibility and Rollback
+
+The implementation targets the current `dev-ai-contest-2026` NuttX baseline
+and Windows VSCode opened through `\\wsl.localhost`. The stock board build
+remains available when the QSPI Kconfig switch is disabled. Rollback consists
+of removing the team-owned scripts/configuration and reversing the patch in
+the NuttX checkout; no Option Byte migration is required.

+  param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
+
+  [int64]$baseAddress = 0
+  [Nullable[int64]]$minAddress = $null
+  [int64]$maxAddress = 0
+
+  foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).Path)) {
+    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line) -or $line[0] -ne ':') {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    [int64]$byteCount = [Convert]::ToInt32($line.Substring(1, 2), 16)
+    [int64]$offset = [Convert]::ToInt32($line.Substring(3, 4), 16)
+    $recordType = [Convert]::ToInt32($line.Substring(7, 2), 16)

+    switch ($recordType) {
+      0 {
+        [int64]$start = $baseAddress + $offset
+        [int64]$end = $start + $byteCount
+        if (-not $minAddress.HasValue -or $start -lt $minAddress.Value) {
+          $minAddress = $start
+        }
+        if ($end -gt $maxAddress) {

+# Windows VS Code 编译、烧录与调试 STM32H750B-DK
+
+## 方案边界
+
+STM32H750XBH6 只有 128 KiB 片内 Flash。超过该容量的 openvela 镜像采用：
+
+```text
+0x08000000  片内 Flash：QSPI boot stub
+0x90000000  外部 QSPI：NuttX/openvela XIP 主镜像
+```
+
+本项目固定以下职责，避免再次把不存在的片内空间声明给 OpenOCD：
+
+- WSL：编译 Linux 工具链下的 openvela。
+- STM32CubeProgrammer：使用
+  `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr` 写入外部 QSPI，再写入片内 boot
+  stub。
+- OpenOCD：只作为 Cortex-Debug 的 GDB server，不负责 QSPI 下载。
+
+历史提交 `5eb5070` 已在本板验证：xPack OpenOCD 的 `stmqspi` 无法稳定
+JEDEC probe/write 双 MT25TL01G，而上述 CubeProgrammer External Loader 可以
+正常擦写和校验。
+
+## 1. 环境
+
+在 Windows 安装：
+
+- VS Code，以及 `ms-vscode.cpptools`、`marus25.cortex-debug` 扩展；
+- WSL，完整 openvela 工作区位于 WSL 文件系统；
+- STM32CubeCLT/STM32CubeProgrammer；
+- Windows xPack OpenOCD。
+
+请用 Windows VS Code 直接打开：
+
+```text
+\\wsl.localhost\Debian\home\<user>\openvela\contest2026_004_TeamFalcons
+```
+
+不要在 WSL Remote 窗口启动 Windows Cortex-Debug。默认工具路径位于
+`.vscode/settings.json`；若安装位置或 WSL 用户名不同，只需修改该文件。
+
+PowerShell 脚本也支持环境变量：
+
+| 变量 | 用途 |
+|---|---|
+| `OPENVELA_WSL_DISTRO` | WSL 发行版，默认 `Debian` |
+| `OPENVELA_ROOT_WSL` | WSL 中的 openvela 根目录；默认从参赛仓父目录推导 |
+| `OPENVELA_OUT_DIR` | Windows 产物目录，默认 `%TEMP%\openvela-debug` |
+| `STM32_PROGRAMMER_CLI` | `STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe` 完整路径 |
+| `STM32_EXTERNAL_LOADER` | `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr` 完整路径 |
+
+## 2. 编译
+
+按 `Ctrl+Shift+B`，运行：
+
+```text
+openvela: build QSPI firmware
+```
+
+构建脚本会：
+
+1. 将团队仓内的 QSPI 补丁幂等应用到当前 NuttX checkout；
+2. 配置官方 `stm32h750b-dk:lvgl`；
+3. 启用 `CONFIG_STM32H750B_DK_QSPI_BOOT`；
+4. 构建主镜像和内部 boot stub；
+5. 复制以下文件到 `%TEMP%\openvela-debug`：
+
+```text
+nuttx.elf  nuttx.hex  nuttx.bin
+qspi_bootstub.elf  qspi_bootstub.hex  qspi_bootstub.bin
+```
+
+调试构建使用任务 `openvela: build debug QSPI firmware`，它额外启用 `-g3`
+和无优化构建。
+
+## 3. 下载
+
+运行：
+
+```text
+openvela: flash QSPI firmware (CubeProgrammer)
+```
+
+脚本在连接硬件前检查：
+
+- 主 HEX 全部位于 `0x90000000..0x97ffffff`；
+- boot stub 全部位于 `0x08000000..0x0801ffff`；
+- CubeProgrammer CLI 与 External Loader 存在。
+
+随后依次执行：
+
+```text
+Cube + External Loader → 写入并校验 QSPI 主镜像
+Cube                   → 写入并校验片内 boot stub
+Cube                   → 复位
+```
+
+已有产物时可使用 `openvela: flash only (CubeProgrammer)`。
+
+## 4. 断点调试
+
+选择：
+
+```text
+openvela: STM32H750B-DK debug after Cube flash
+```
+
+按 `F5` 后会先构建并用 CubeProgrammer 下载 debug 镜像，再由 OpenOCD
+启动 GDB server。配置使用 `request: attach` 和空 `loadFiles`，因此 GDB 只
+加载 `%TEMP%\openvela-debug\nuttx.elf` 的符号，不会再次写 Flash。
+
+若固件已经下载，使用 `openvela: STM32H750B-DK attach only`。
+
+## 5. 故障恢复
+
+- `Main QSPI image address range is invalid`：构建未启用 QSPI linker，禁止下载。
+- 找不到 External Loader：检查 STM32CubeProgrammer 安装，或设置
+  `STM32_EXTERNAL_LOADER`。
+- OpenOCD 无法 attach：关闭 CubeProgrammer GUI 和其他 OpenOCD 进程，确认
+  ST-LINK 未被占用。
+- QSPI 下载成功但不启动：先检查 boot stub 是否写入片内 Flash，再检查复位后
+  PC 是否进入 `0x9000xxxx`。
+- 芯片保护或连接异常：在 CubeProgrammer GUI 中检查 Option Bytes；记录原值后
+  再处理。正常流程不会自动修改 Option Bytes 或执行 mass erase。
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> str:
+    try:
+        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return ""
+
+
+def hex_range(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    base = 0
+    low: int | None = None
+    high = 0
+
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="ascii").splitlines():
+        if not line.startswith(":"):
+            continue
+
+        count = int(line[1:3], 16)
+        offset = int(line[3:7], 16)
+        record_type = int(line[7:9], 16)
+        if record_type == 0:
+            start = base + offset
+            end = start + count
+            low = start if low is None else min(low, start)
+            high = max(high, end)
+        elif record_type == 2:
+            base = int(line[9:13], 16) << 4
+        elif record_type == 4:
+            base = int(line[9:13], 16) << 16
+
+    if low is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"no data records in {path}")
+    return low, high
+
+
+class Checks:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.failed = 0
+
+    def check(self, condition: bool, label: str, detail: str = "") -> None:

+        suffix = f" ({detail})" if detail else ""
+        print(f"{status}: {label}{suffix}")
+        if not condition:
+            self.failed += 1
+

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/spec/backend/stm32h750-qspi-toolchain.md
+# STM32H750 QSPI Build, Flash, and Debug Contract
+
+## Scenario: Windows VS Code workflow for oversized STM32H750 firmware
+
+### 1. Scope / Trigger
+
+This contract applies when building, programming, or debugging openvela on the
+STM32H750B-DK from Windows VS Code, especially when the firmware exceeds the
+STM32H750XBH6 physical 128 KiB internal Flash.
+
+The supported architecture is always two-stage:
+
+- `0x08000000..0x0801ffff`: internal-Flash QSPI boot stub.
+- `0x90000000..0x97ffffff`: external-QSPI NuttX XIP image.
+
+Never enlarge the OpenOCD internal Flash bank to make an oversized image appear
+to fit. OpenOCD is the GDB server only; CubeProgrammer owns programming.
+
+### 2. Signatures
+
+Supported entry points:
+
+```powershell
+scripts\windows_build_openvela.ps1
+  [-WslDistro <string>]
+  [-OpenvelaDir <WSL path>]
+  [-BoardConfig <string>]
+  [-OutDir <Windows path>]
+  [-DebugBuild]
+
+scripts\windows_flash_cube.ps1
+  [-CubeCli <Windows file>]
+  [-ExternalLoader <Windows file>]
+  [-OutDir <Windows path>]
+  [-NoBuild]
+  [-DebugBuild]
+  [-ValidateOnly]
+
+scripts\windows_flash_openocd.ps1
+  # Compatibility entry point with the same flash arguments. It must delegate
+  # to windows_flash_cube.ps1 and warn that OpenOCD is debug-only.
+```
+
+The build must invoke the idempotent patch interface before configuring NuttX:
+
+```bash
+scripts/apply-openvela-qspi-patch.sh <openvela-root>
+```
+
+VS Code debug configurations must use Cortex-Debug with `request: "attach"`,
+`.debug/nuttx.elf` as the executable/symbol file, and `loadFiles: []`.
+
+### 3. Contracts
+
+Inputs and environment overrides:
+
+| Name | Type | Required | Contract |
+|---|---|---:|---|
+| `OPENVELA_WSL_DISTRO` | string | no | Defaults to `Debian`. |
+| `OPENVELA_ROOT_WSL` | WSL path | no | Defaults to the parent of the contest repository. |
+| `OPENVELA_OUT_DIR` | Windows path | no | Defaults to `<contest-repo>\.debug`. |
+| `STM32_PROGRAMMER_CLI` | Windows file | for flash | CubeProgrammer CLI path; explicit parameter wins. |
+| `STM32_EXTERNAL_LOADER` | Windows file | for flash | Must resolve to `MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr` or a deliberately validated replacement. |
+
+The build output directory is the single hand-off boundary and must contain:
+
+```text
+nuttx.elf
+nuttx.hex
+nuttx.bin
+qspi_bootstub.elf
+qspi_bootstub.hex
+qspi_bootstub.bin
+```
+
+`nuttx.hex` must contain data only within the external-QSPI window.
+`qspi_bootstub.hex` must contain data only within the physical internal-Flash
+window. Intel HEX upper bounds are exclusive.
+
+The flash sequence is ordered and fail-fast:
+
+1. Validate tools, files, and both HEX ranges without accessing hardware.
+2. Program and verify `nuttx.hex` using the External Loader.
+3. Program and verify `qspi_bootstub.hex` without the External Loader.
+4. Reset the target.
+
+Release builds enable `CONFIG_DEBUG_FULLOPT` and disable debug symbols/no-opt.
+Debug builds enable `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS`, `-g3`, and `CONFIG_DEBUG_NOOPT`.
+Both builds enable `CONFIG_STM32H750B_DK_QSPI_BOOT`.
+
+### 4. Validation & Error Matrix
+
+| Condition | Required result |
+|---|---|
+| `wsl.exe` is missing | Stop before build with an actionable error. |
+| Windows/UNC path cannot convert to WSL | Stop and name the failing path. |
+| QSPI patch is neither cleanly applicable nor already applied | Stop before configure/build. |
+| `nuttx.hex` has data below `0x90000000` or at/above `0x98000000` | Reject before CubeProgrammer starts. |
+| Boot-stub HEX has data below `0x08000000` or at/above `0x08020000` | Reject before CubeProgrammer starts. |
+| Required HEX file, Cube CLI, or External Loader is missing | Stop and identify the missing input. |
+| `-ValidateOnly` is set | Validate all software inputs and exit without opening ST-LINK. |
+| QSPI program/verify fails | Stop; do not program the stub or reset. |
+| Internal-stub program/verify fails | Stop; do not report success or continue to reset. |
+| No ST-LINK is connected | Report hardware validation as pending, never as passed. |
+| Debug is launched | Attach with symbols; never download from GDB/OpenOCD. |
+
+Normal scripts must not alter Option Bytes, mass erase the device, or claim an
+OpenOCD flash bank larger than the chip's physical internal Flash.
+
+### 5. Good / Base / Bad Cases
+
+- Good: a debug build emits a symbolized `nuttx.elf` at `0x90000000`, Cube
+  programs both images, cold boot reaches `0x9000xxxx`, and OpenOCD attaches to
+  a working source breakpoint without downloading.
+- Base: with no board attached, build plus `-NoBuild -ValidateOnly` proves the
+  tool paths, artifact presence, and address layout; hardware acceptance stays
+  pending.
+- Bad: an oversized `0x08000000` image is sent to OpenOCD, an arbitrary QSPI
+  driver is expected to probe the board's dual MT25TL01G arrangement, or an
+  External Loader is used without checking the HEX address window.
+
+### 6. Tests Required
+
+For any change to this workflow, assert all applicable points:
+
+1. Parse `.vscode/*.json` and all three PowerShell scripts successfully.
+2. Run Bash syntax checks and Python compilation for changed helpers.
+3. Build release and debug variants; inspect ELF/HEX ranges and confirm debug
+   sections are present only where intended.
+4. Run `python3 harness/qspi_boot_flow_check.py --artifacts .debug`; every
+   assertion must pass.
+5. Run `windows_flash_cube.ps1 -NoBuild -ValidateOnly` on Windows; confirm it
+   does not access ST-LINK.
+6. With hardware connected, program both images, power-cycle the board, verify
+   serial/NSH startup and a PC in `0x9000xxxx`, then attach OpenOCD and hit a
+   source breakpoint.
+
+Software-only checks do not substitute for step 6. Record the exact hardware

+
+#### Wrong
+
+```text
+# Pretend the H750 has 2 MiB internal Flash, then ask OpenOCD to download an
+# oversized image beginning at 0x08000000.
+flash bank stm32h7x 0x08000000 0x200000 ...
+```
+
+This violates the silicon capacity and does not solve external-QSPI loading.
+
+#### Correct
+
+```text
+CubeProgrammer + MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr
+  -> verify NuttX XIP HEX at 0x90000000
+CubeProgrammer
+  -> verify boot stub at 0x08000000
+OpenOCD + Cortex-Debug request=attach + loadFiles=[]
+  -> debug using .debug/nuttx.elf symbols only
+```

+The External Loader contains the board-specific QSPI programming algorithm;
+the boot stub initializes memory-mapped QSPI for execution after reset.

不是卡死，是触摸驱动接口不兼容，根因已经确定。

当前情况：

- LVGL 9.2.1 成功打开 `/dev/input0`
- 随后调用 `TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS`
- FT5X06 驱动只实现了：
  - `TSIOC_SETFREQUENCY`
  - `TSIOC_GETFREQUENCY`
- 其他 ioctl 一律返回 `-ENOTTY`
- 因此 LVGL 收到 `errno=25` 后关闭触摸设备，界面继续运行但永远收不到触摸事件

当前配置为：

```text
CONFIG_FT5X06_SINGLEPOINT=y
CONFIG_FT5X06_SWAPXY=y
```

正确修复是在 FT5X06 驱动的 `ft5x06_ioctl()` 中实现 `TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS`，单点模式返回 `1`，多点模式返回 `FT5X06_MAX_TOUCHES`。相比在 LVGL 中忽略错误，这是更干净的驱动层修复。

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/tasks/07-12-stm32h750-qspi-flash-debug/prd.md
@@
 - R9: Document the tool boundary, artifact addresses, setup, recovery path,
   and diagnostics in Chinese.
+- R10: Keep the built-in FT5X06 touchscreen compatible with LVGL 9.2.1 by
+  implementing the standard `TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS` ioctl in the legacy driver;
+  return one point for `CONFIG_FT5X06_SINGLEPOINT` and the hardware maximum
+  otherwise.
@@
 - [ ] AC7: On hardware, cold boot reaches a PC in `0x9000xxxx`, serial output
   reaches NSH or the configured application, and a source breakpoint can be
   hit after attach. Hardware-only checks are explicitly reported if the board
   or Windows tools are unavailable in the execution environment.
+- [ ] AC8: `lvgldemo widgets` opens `/dev/input0` without the
+  `TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS`/`ENOTTY` error and touch press, release, and drag events
+  affect the on-screen widgets with coordinates matching the display.
*** Update File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/tasks/07-12-stm32h750-qspi-flash-debug/design.md
@@
 ## Compatibility and Rollback
@@
 of removing the team-owned scripts/configuration and reversing the patch in
 the NuttX checkout; no Option Byte migration is required.
+
+## FT5X06 / LVGL Input Compatibility
+
+LVGL 9.2.1 requires touchscreen devices to answer
+`TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS` before it creates an input device. The board's existing
+legacy FT5X06 character driver only handles frequency ioctls and returns
+`-ENOTTY`, despite successfully opening and reading the hardware.
+
+The compatibility fix stays at the driver contract boundary: add
+`TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS` to `ft5x06_ioctl()`, validate the output pointer, return
+one point under `CONFIG_FT5X06_SINGLEPOINT`, and return
+`FT5X06_MAX_TOUCHES` otherwise. This is intentionally smaller than migrating
+the established driver to the newer touchscreen upper-half, and safer than
+teaching LVGL to assume a point count after arbitrary ioctl failures. The
+change is carried by the same team-owned, idempotent NuttX patch.
*** Update File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/tasks/07-12-stm32h750-qspi-flash-debug/implement.md
@@
 6. Review and rollback gates.
@@
    - Record hardware validation as pending if Windows Cube tools/ST-LINK are
      unavailable.
+7. Restore the FT5X06/LVGL touchscreen contract discovered during hardware
+   validation.
+   - Add `TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS` handling to the maintained NuttX patch and the
+     generated checkout.
+   - Add a static regression assertion and run NuttX style/build checks.
+   - Rebuild, program with CubeProgrammer, start `lvgldemo widgets`, and verify
+     that LVGL opens the input device and receives touch interaction.
*** End Patch";

修改代码后，按 `Ctrl+Shift+B`：

```text
openvela: build QSPI firmware
```

它会在 WSL 中构建，并在 `.debug` 生成：

```text
nuttx.elf
nuttx.hex
nuttx.bin
qspi_bootstub.elf
qspi_bootstub.hex
qspi_bootstub.bin
```

业务代码应尽量维护在当前参赛仓的 `app/`、`board/` 等目录。涉及上游 NuttX 的修改不能只留在 `../nuttx`，还要同步维护到项目补丁中，否则重新同步工作区后会丢失。

## 烧录

在 VS Code 执行任务：

```text
openvela: flash QSPI firmware (CubeProgrammer)
```

它会自动完成：

1. 编译 release 固件。
2. 用 External Loader 把 `nuttx.hex` 烧到 `0x90000000`。
3. 把 boot stub 烧到片内 Flash `0x08000000`。
4. 校验两个镜像。
5. 复位开发板。

只想烧录已有产物时使用：

```text
openvela: flash only (CubeProgrammer)
```

本项目中 CubeProgrammer 是唯一烧录工具；OpenOCD 不负责 QSPI 下载。

## 断点调试

打开 VS Code“运行和调试”，选择：

```text
openvela: STM32H750B-DK debug after Cube flash
```

按 `F5`。VS Code 会：

1. 生成 debug 固件。
2. 用 CubeProgrammer 烧录。
3. 启动 OpenOCD GDB Server。
4. 使用 `.debug/nuttx.elf` 加载符号。
5. attach 到正在 QSPI 中运行的程序。

如果固件没有变化，只是想重新连接或换断点，选择：

```text
openvela: STM32H750B-DK attach only
```

改过代码后不要直接 `attach only`，否则板上固件和 ELF 符号可能不一致。

当前调试配置使用：

```json
"request": "attach",
"loadFiles": []
```

+
+## Goal
+
+Replace the stock `lvgldemo` runtime experiment with a team-owned LVGL
+application that starts automatically on STM32H750B-DK and makes the complete
+Windows VS Code build, CubeProgrammer flash, and OpenOCD attach workflow easy
+to verify.

+## Chosen approach
+
+The application remains in the existing team-owned `app/hello_app` manifest
+slot to avoid changing workspace manifests, but its program and user-facing
+identity become `vscode_lab`. The Windows build wrapper enables this app,
+disables the stock LVGL demo application, and changes `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT`
+to `vscode_lab_main`.
+
+`vscode_lab_main` creates a dedicated LVGL UI task and then calls `nsh_main`.
+The display therefore starts without a serial command while NSH remains
+available on the ST-LINK virtual COM port.
+
+Alternatives rejected:
+
+- An NSH `rcS` script adds ROMFS/startup-script dependencies to a board config
+  that does not currently use them.
+- Starting the app from `board_late_initialize()` couples a team experiment to
+  upstream STM32 board code and makes rollback harder.
+
+## Application components
+
+`app/hello_app` will contain:
+
+- `Kconfig`: `LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_004_VSCODE_LAB`, stack size, priority,
+  framebuffer path, and touchscreen path.
+- `CMakeLists.txt`, `Makefile`, and `Make.defs`: register the built-in program
+  as `vscode_lab`, with LVGL as a dependency.
+- `vscode_lab_main.c`: boot hand-off, LVGL initialization/event loop, UI, touch
+  callbacks, and serial diagnostics.
+
+The initial UI contains:
+
+- title and fixed firmware label;
+- heartbeat/uptime label proving the event loop is alive;
+- touch counter;
+- `Breakpoint +1` button;
+- slider and numeric slider-value label;
+- short on-screen instructions for the VS Code experiment.
+
+## Debug contract
+
+The source exports these stable debug points:
+
+```c
+struct vscode_lab_debug_state
+{
+  volatile uint32_t button_count;
+  volatile int32_t slider_value;
+  volatile uint32_t uptime_seconds;
+};
+
+extern struct vscode_lab_debug_state g_vscode_lab_debug_state;
+
+void vscode_lab_debug_checkpoint(uint32_t button_count,
+                                 int32_t slider_value);
+```
+
+`vscode_lab_debug_checkpoint()` is non-static and `noinline`. Every button
+click updates `g_vscode_lab_debug_state`, logs the values, and calls the
+checkpoint. A debug ELF must retain both symbols so Cortex-Debug can set a
+source or function breakpoint before the user touches the button.
+
+The slider updates its label and debug state. It logs only on release to avoid
+flooding the serial port while dragging.
+
+## Startup and data flow
+
+```text
+NuttX init
+  -> vscode_lab_main
+       -> task_create(vscode_lab_ui)
+       -> nsh_main (serial shell remains available)
+
+vscode_lab_ui
+  -> board/LVGL initialization
+  -> /dev/lcd0 + /dev/input0
+  -> create widgets
+  -> lv_timer_handler loop
+
+touch button
+  -> increment state
+  -> update label
+  -> vscode_lab_debug_checkpoint (VS Code breakpoint)
+```
+
+Only the UI task calls LVGL. NSH and debug reads may observe the volatile
+state but do not mutate LVGL objects.
+
+## Failure handling
+
+- Failure to create the UI task is printed to the serial console; NSH still
+  starts so the target remains diagnosable.
+- Failure to initialize a display is logged and the UI task exits without
+  taking down NSH.
+- A second manual `vscode_lab` invocation is rejected using a guarded running
+  flag, preventing two LVGL owners from opening the same devices.
+- The existing QSPI address validation and Cube/OpenOCD tool boundaries remain
+  unchanged.
+
+## Build integration
+
+The Windows build wrapper will configure `stm32h750b-dk:lvgl`, then:
+
+1. enable `CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_004_VSCODE_LAB`;
+2. disable `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_LVGLDEMO`;
+3. set `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="vscode_lab_main"`;
+4. retain the QSPI, touchscreen, NSH, release, and debug settings already
+   validated by the project.
+
+The team app is already exposed to openvela through the contest workspace's
+`packages/demos/contest2026_004_hello_app` link. The maintained directory name
+is legacy scaffold metadata; no openvela demo source is reused.
+
+## Validation
+
+Software checks:
+
+1. C/CMake/Kconfig static checks and project harness pass.
+2. Release and debug QSPI builds succeed.
+3. `nuttx.hex` remains entirely inside `0x90000000..0x97ffffff` and the boot
+   stub remains inside the physical 128 KiB internal Flash.
+4. `arm-none-eabi-nm .debug/nuttx.elf` contains `vscode_lab_main`,
+   `vscode_lab_debug_checkpoint`, and `g_vscode_lab_debug_state`.
+5. The generated config selects the team app, uses its init entrypoint, and
+   does not select `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_LVGLDEMO`.
+
+Hardware checks:
+
+1. CubeProgrammer programs and verifies both images.
+2. The VS Code Lab screen appears automatically after reset without entering

+3. Uptime changes, the button increments, and the slider follows touch input.
+4. COM7 still reaches an `nsh>` prompt and prints application events.
+5. Cortex-Debug attach hits `vscode_lab_debug_checkpoint()` when the button is
+   pressed, with state values visible in the debugger.
+
+## Out of scope
+
+- Product-specific VelaGuard behavior.
+- Replacing the existing QSPI boot architecture.
+- Teaching OpenOCD to program the dual external QSPI device.
+- Additional screens, persistence, networking, or production UI styling.

## 一、首次配置

### 1. 安装 Windows 软件

安装：

- Windows VS Code
- VS Code 扩展：
  - `C/C++`
  - `Cortex-Debug`
- STM32CubeCLT 或 STM32CubeProgrammer
- xPack OpenOCD
- WSL Debian

项目和完整 openvela 源码应放在 WSL 文件系统中，例如：

```text
/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons
```

### 2. 用 Windows VS Code 打开项目

在 Windows VS Code 中选择“文件 → 打开文件夹”，输入：

```text
\\wsl.localhost\Debian\home\debian19y\openvela\contest2026_004_TeamFalcons
```

关键点：

- 使用普通的 Windows VS Code 窗口
- 不要使用 “Remote - WSL” 窗口
- ST-LINK 应连接到 Windows，不需要转发给 WSL

否则 Windows Cortex-Debug、CubeProgrammer 可能无法访问 ST-LINK。

### 3. 检查工具路径

打开 [.vscode/settings.json](/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.vscode/settings.json)，确认下面三个路径与你的实际安装位置一致：

```json
{
  "cortex-debug.openocdPath.windows": "D:/Develop/xpack-openocd-0.12.0-7/bin/openocd.exe",
  "cortex-debug.armToolchainPath.windows": "D:/Develop/STM32CubeCLT/GNU-tools-for-STM32/bin",
  "cortex-debug.gdbPath.windows": "D:/Develop/STM32CubeCLT/GNU-tools-for-STM32/bin/arm-none-eabi-gdb.exe"
}
```

还要确认 Cube External Loader 存在：

```text
STM32CubeProgrammer\bin\ExternalLoader\
MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr
```

脚本会自动搜索常见安装路径。如果没有找到，可以设置 Windows 环境变量：

```powershell
setx STM32_PROGRAMMER_CLI "D:\...\STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe"
setx STM32_EXTERNAL_LOADER "D:\...\MT25TL01G_STM32H750B-DISCO.stldr"
```

设置后重新启动 VS Code。

## 二、编译

在 VS Code 中按：

```text
Ctrl+Shift+B
```

选择或直接执行：

```text
openvela: build QSPI firmware
```

它会调用 Windows PowerShell，再通过 WSL 编译 openvela。

编译完成后检查项目的 `.debug` 目录：

```text
.debug/
├── nuttx.elf
├── nuttx.hex
├── nuttx.bin
├── qspi_bootstub.elf
├── qspi_bootstub.hex
└── qspi_bootstub.bin
```

其中：

- `nuttx.*`：外部 QSPI 主程序，地址从 `0x90000000` 开始
- `qspi_bootstub.*`：片内 Flash 启动程序，地址从 `0x08000000` 开始

需要带完整调试符号时，在命令面板中执行：

```text
Tasks: Run Task
```

然后选择：

```text
openvela: build debug QSPI firmware
```

## 三、烧录下载

连接开发板的 ST-LINK USB，然后关闭可能占用 ST-LINK 的 CubeProgrammer GUI、其他 OpenOCD 或调试器。

在 VS Code 中按：

```text
Ctrl+Shift+P
```

运行：

```text
Tasks: Run Task
```

选择：

```text
openvela: flash QSPI firmware (CubeProgrammer)
```

该任务会自动完成：

```text
编译
  ↓
Cube External Loader 烧录 nuttx.hex 到 0x90000000
  ↓
CubeProgrammer 烧录 boot stub 到 0x08000000
  ↓
校验
  ↓
复位开发板
```

如果代码已经编译，只想重新烧录现有 `.debug` 文件，选择：

```text
openvela: flash only (CubeProgrammer)
```

正常情况下，冷启动后会直接显示 `VS Code Lab` 界面。

## 四、断点调试

### 1. 设置测试断点

打开：

[vscode_lab_main.c](/home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/app/hello_app/vscode_lab_main.c)

找到函数：

```c

```

在函数内部左侧行号栏点击，设置断点。

### 2. 编译、烧录并启动调试

进入 VS Code 左侧“运行和调试”，选择：

```text
openvela: STM32H750B-DK debug after Cube flash
```

按：

```text
F5
```

这个配置会自动：

1. 编译 Debug 固件
2. 用 CubeProgrammer 烧录 QSPI 和 boot stub
3. 启动 OpenOCD
4. 用 GDB 加载 `.debug/nuttx.elf` 的符号
5. Attach 到正在运行的开发板

它不会让 OpenOCD重新下载固件。

界面出现后，点击屏幕上的：

```text
Breakpoint +1
```

VS Code 应停在 `vscode_lab_debug_checkpoint()`，此时可以：

- 查看局部变量
- 查看调用栈
- 单步执行
- 查看全局变量 `g_vscode_lab_debug_state`
- 按 `F5` 继续运行

### 3. 只重新连接调试器

如果没有修改和重新编译固件，只想再次调试，选择：

```text
openvela: STM32H750B-DK attach only
```

这会避免重复擦写 QSPI。

如果修改过代码，不要使用 `attach only`，否则板上程序与 `.debug/nuttx.elf` 的符号可能不一致。

这不是 QSPI 或 External Loader 错误。日志已经证明镜像和 Loader 检查通过；失败发生在 CubeProgrammer 与 ST-LINK 建立 USB 通信时。

最常见原因是 ST-LINK 被 OpenOCD/GDB 占用，或者通过 `usbipd` 连接给了 WSL。

按以下顺序处理。

### 1. 结束所有调试进程

先在 VS Code 按：

```text
Shift+F5
```

关闭 CubeProgrammer GUI，然后在 Windows PowerShell 执行：

```powershell
Get-Process openocd,arm-none-eabi-gdb,STM32CubeProgrammer,STM32_Programmer_CLI `
  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
```

### 2. 检查 ST-LINK 是否被转发给 WSL

在 Windows PowerShell 执行：

```powershell
usbipd list
```

找到名称包含 `ST-LINK` 或 `STM32 STLink` 的设备。

如果状态是 `Attached`，记下它的 `BUSID`，例如 `1-4`，然后执行：

```powershell
usbipd detach --busid 1-4
```

本项目要求：

```text
ST-LINK → Windows
编译工具 → WSL
```

ST-LINK 不应连接给 WSL。

### 3. 重新连接开发板

完全拔掉开发板 USB，等待数秒，再插入 ST-LINK 对应的 USB 接口。尽量：

- 不使用 USB Hub
- 换一个 Windows USB 接口
- 确认使用的是 ST-LINK USB 口
- 确认开发板电源指示灯正常

### 4. 单独检查 CubeProgrammer 能否发现探针

执行：

```powershell
& "D:\Develop\STM32CubeCLT\STM32CubeProgrammer\bin\STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe" -l
```

正常应列出 ST-LINK 序列号。如果没有列出，问题仍在 Windows USB、驱动或设备占用，与项目固件无关。

如果能列出，再测试连接：

```powershell
& "D:\Develop\STM32CubeCLT\STM32CubeProgrammer\bin\STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe" `
  -c port=SWD mode=UR freq=1000
```

连接成功后重新运行 VS Code 任务：

```text
openvela: flash only (CubeProgrammer)
```

打开 STM32CubeProgrammer GUI，检查：

- ST-LINK Firmware Upgrade
- Windows 设备管理器是否出现 ST-LINK
- 是否需要重新安装 ST-LINK USB Driver
- 有没有另一个 VS Code/OpenOCD/CubeProgrammer 窗口占用探针

 # Fix Windows PowerShell debug flash argument forwarding
 
 ## Goal
 
-TBD.
+Make the Windows VS Code debug-flash task pass named options to child
+PowerShell scripts without those options being rebound as positional values.
 
-## Requirements
+## Background
 
-- TBD
+Running `windows_flash_cube.ps1 -DebugBuild` currently invokes
+`windows_build_openvela.ps1` through an array of strings. PowerShell treats the
+array elements as positional arguments, producing this observed binding:
+
+- `WslDistro = "-DebugBuild"`
+- `OpenvelaDir = "-OutDir"`
+
+The build then fails with `WSL_E_DISTRO_NOT_FOUND`. The OpenOCD compatibility
+wrapper uses the same forwarding pattern and has the same latent defect.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- Replace string-array parameter forwarding with named hashtable splatting in
+  `scripts/windows_flash_cube.ps1`.
+- Apply the same correction to `scripts/windows_flash_openocd.ps1`.
+- Preserve existing defaults, switches, output paths, task labels, QSPI
+  validation, programming order, and OpenOCD's debug-only policy.
+- Keep the change limited to argument forwarding and regression coverage.
+- The fix must work for both release and `-DebugBuild` invocations and for
+  optional explicit Cube CLI, External Loader, output directory, no-build, and
+  validate-only arguments.
 
 ## Acceptance Criteria
 
-- [ ] TBD
+- [ ] `windows_flash_cube.ps1 -DebugBuild` forwards `DebugBuild=$true` and the
+  real `.debug` output path by parameter name.
+- [ ] A normal flash invocation still performs a release build when
+  `-DebugBuild` is absent.
+- [ ] `windows_flash_openocd.ps1` forwards every supported option by name to
+  `windows_flash_cube.ps1`.
+- [ ] The QSPI boot-flow harness detects regression to string-array splatting.
+- [ ] The existing QSPI boot-flow harness, contest harness, and
+  `git diff --check` pass.
+- [ ] A Windows VS Code `openvela: flash debug firmware (CubeProgrammer)` run
+  reports `Building debug QSPI-XIP firmware in WSL distro 'Debian'` rather
+  than treating `-DebugBuild` as the distro name.
+
+## Out of Scope
+
+- Changing WSL installation or distribution names.
+- Changing CubeProgrammer, External Loader, OpenOCD, or ST-LINK behavior.
+- Refactoring the build or flash pipeline beyond the two forwarding sites.
*** Add File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-12-powershell-argument-forwarding-design.md
+# PowerShell Argument Forwarding Fix Design
+
+## Problem
+
+The Windows debug-flash task passes `-DebugBuild` and `-OutDir` to a child
+PowerShell script through a string array. Array splatting does not preserve the
+tokens as named parameters for this script invocation, so the child binds them
+positionally and attempts to open a WSL distribution named `-DebugBuild`.
+
+The same pattern exists in the OpenOCD compatibility wrapper.
+
+## Chosen Design
+
+Use PowerShell hashtable splatting at both forwarding boundaries. Each key is
+the destination script's real parameter name, and switch keys are included
+only when enabled. This keeps PowerShell's parameter binder authoritative and
+avoids positional dependence.
+
+The Cube flash script will always pass `OutDir` by name and conditionally pass
+`DebugBuild`. The OpenOCD wrapper will conditionally populate all explicitly
+provided paths and switches before forwarding them to the Cube flash script.
+
+## Alternatives Considered
+
+- Duplicate explicit script calls for debug and release modes. This is
+  reliable but repeats the invocation and becomes harder to maintain as
+  options are added.
+- Make child scripts accept malformed positional input. This hides the caller
+  defect and weakens the parameter contract.
+
+Hashtable splatting is the smallest idiomatic fix and preserves the existing
+script interfaces.
+
+## Compatibility and Error Handling
+
+No VS Code task names, public script parameters, default paths, build flags,
+or flash sequencing change. Existing failures from WSL, CubeProgrammer, image
+validation, and ST-LINK remain visible with their existing exit behavior.
+
+## Validation
+
+Extend the QSPI boot-flow harness to require named hashtable forwarding and to
+reject the prior string-array construction. Run the QSPI harness, the contest
+harness, and `git diff --check`. The final hardware acceptance test runs the
+Windows debug-flash task and verifies that the log names `Debian` as the WSL
+distribution and `debug` as the build kind.
*** End Patch";

 # Implement Issue 01 Bootable VelaGuard Skeleton
 
 ## Goal
 
-TBD.
+Deliver the first hardware-bootable VelaGuard product slice on
+STM32H750B-DK/openvela, replacing the development-only VS Code Lab as the
+default firmware application while preserving the proven QSPI build, flash,
+touch, cold-boot, and attach-debug workflow.
+
+## Background
+
+The authoritative product issue is
+`.scratch/velaguard-independent-edge-ai-gateway/issues/01-bootable-velaguard-skeleton.md`.
+The previous implementation on historical branch `5eb5070` established useful
+module seams but did not close production Device ID validation, storage/log
+failure visibility, or reproducible integration without a separate Issue 1
+NuttX patch. Its five equal status cards also do not provide a strong visual
+hierarchy on the 480x272 display.
+
+The current branch has a hardware-validated QSPI-XIP boot stub, CubeProgrammer
+External Loader flow, framebuffer/LVGL initialization, FT5X06 compatibility,
+NSH-preserving app startup, Windows VS Code tasks, and source debugging. ISSUE1
+must build on this baseline rather than reintroducing the old boot path.
 
 ## Requirements
 
-- TBD
+- Add a project-owned VelaGuard application with separate identity, startup
+  record, and LVGL home-screen modules.
+- Start board services through `nsh_initialize()`, run the LVGL UI in its own
+  task, and preserve `nsh_consolemain()` on the serial console.
+- Support explicit test and production product modes independently from
+  release/debug compiler optimization.
+- Test mode accepts only a compile-time Device ID override.
+- Production mode derives the Device ID from the STM32H750 96-bit UID and adds
+  no runtime edit path.
+- Create or verify `/data/velaguard`, `/data/velaguard/configs`, and
+  `/data/velaguard/logs` during startup.
+- Append one human-readable startup record and one JSONL boot event containing
+  Device ID, build mode, firmware version, boot ID, `ts_ms`, `uptime_ms`, and
+  time quality.
+- Expose storage/event success or degradation on both serial output and the
+  home screen.
+- Display device identity, build mode, firmware version, and distinct status
+  areas for acquisition, alarm, network, audio, and time.
+- Preserve the current QSPI address boundaries, CubeProgrammer flash ownership,
+  OpenOCD attach-only policy, framebuffer path, and touch-driver compatibility.
+- Keep Modbus, real sensor acquisition, networking, MQTT, AI, audio playback,
+  OTA, and runtime configuration outside this issue.
+- Follow the user-requested `design-taste-frontend` audit and pre-flight rules
+  where they apply to a fixed 480x272 industrial LVGL product surface.
+
+## Visual Constraints
+
+- One fixed dark industrial theme suitable for the embedded HMI; this is not a
+  consumer web page and does not require a browser dark-mode toggle.
+- One cyan product accent; red and amber are reserved for semantic alarm and
+  warning states.
+- Consistent 8 px panel radius, WCAG-like readable contrast, no decorative
+  status dots, no five-equal-card template, and no gratuitous animation.
+- English UI copy for the first slice because the enabled LVGL Montserrat fonts
+  do not provide Chinese glyph coverage.
+- Every required placeholder communicates an honest state such as awaiting
+  source, no active alarm, offline, unavailable, or unsynced.
 
 ## Acceptance Criteria
 
-- [ ] TBD
+- [ ] Test and production QSPI images build from the team repository workflow.
+- [ ] The test image shows the configured override; the production image shows
+  a UID-derived stable Device ID with no runtime editor.
+- [ ] A cold boot reaches the VelaGuard home screen without a connected PC.
+- [ ] Repeated production cold boots show the same Device ID.
+- [ ] The display shows VelaGuard, build mode, firmware version, Device ID,
+  storage/event state, and all five required product status placeholders.
+- [ ] Startup creates/verifies the three directories and writes both log files,
+  or shows a clear degraded state if the filesystem cannot provide them.
+- [ ] The structured boot event contains all required fields and valid JSONL.
+- [ ] Serial NSH remains available and reports the same identity/startup state.
+- [ ] Touch input initializes without breaking the non-interactive ISSUE1 home
+  screen, and OpenOCD attach debugging loads symbols without programming QSPI.
+- [ ] Static harnesses, release/debug builds, HEX range checks, cold boot, and
+  source breakpoint validation pass.
+- [ ] The Taste pre-flight applicable to an embedded industrial screen passes:
+  hierarchy, color/shape consistency, copy audit, contrast, restrained motion,
+  and absence of generic equal-card layout.
+
+## Out of Scope
+
+- Modbus acquisition and state machines from Issues 02-04.
+- Durable configuration recovery, durable rolling logs, and storage mounting
+  policy from Issues 05 and 13.
+- Ethernet/Wi-Fi, MQTT, AI Bridge, Candidate Configuration, audio, and OTA.
+- Changes to public openvela source trees as the ISSUE1 product implementation.
*** End Patch";

可选实现方案：

1. 新建 `app/velaguard_app`，保留 VS Code Lab，并扩展现有 QSPI 构建脚本支持 VelaGuard test/production 模式（推荐）

   优点：产品代码边界清晰；保留已验证实验；test/production 与 Debug/Release 两个维度互不混淆。缺点是需要更新 manifest 和 VS Code 任务。

2. 直接把 `app/hello_app` 改成 VelaGuard

   优点：集成最简单。缺点：目录语义错误，并丢失已经验证的 VS Code Lab。

3. 从旧分支恢复 ISSUE1 实现再修补

   优点：速度快。缺点：会带回旧启动路径、五等分卡片 UI、日志降级不可见等已知问题。

推荐方案 1。

架构设计：

```text
velaguard_main
  ├─ nsh_initialize()          板级设备初始化
  ├─ vg_identity_init()        test override / production UID
  ├─ vg_startup_record()       目录、文本日志、JSONL 事件
  ├─ task_create(UI)           LVGL framebuffer + touch + 首页
  └─ nsh_consolemain()         保留 COM7/NSH
```

产品代码分为：

- `vg_identity`：只负责稳定 Device ID 和构建模式
- `vg_startup`：只负责启动上下文、目录和启动事件
- `vg_ui_home`：只消费启动状态，不自行访问 UID 或文件系统
- `velaguard_main`：负责启动顺序和降级传播

构建脚本增加独立的 `VelaGuardMode=test|production`，保留现有 `DebugBuild`。这样可以组合出 test-debug、test-release、production-debug、production-release，而不会再把“生产模式”等同于“编译优化”。

+# ISSUE1 Bootable VelaGuard Skeleton Design
+
+## Boundaries
+
+ISSUE1 creates the VelaGuard product process and its first observable boot
+state. It owns identity, startup records, and the LVGL home screen. It does not
+implement real acquisition, alarms, networking, audio, AI, configuration, or
+OTA.
+
+The implementation remains inside the team repository. A manifest link exposes
+`app/velaguard_app` to openvela. The build helper may repair that generated
+contest-owned link, but ISSUE1 adds no public-tree source patch. The existing
+QSPI and FT5X06 compatibility patch remains a build-platform dependency and is
+not extended for VelaGuard behavior.
+
+## Process Architecture
+
+```text
+velaguard_main
+  -> nsh_initialize()
+  -> vg_identity_init()
+  -> vg_startup_record()
+  -> task_create(velaguard_ui)
+  -> nsh_consolemain()
+
+velaguard_ui
+  -> lv_init()
+  -> lv_nuttx_dsc_init()
+  -> lv_nuttx_init()
+  -> vg_ui_home_create()
+  -> lv_timer_handler() loop
+```
+
+`nsh_initialize()` owns board initialization. Keeping `nsh_consolemain()` in
+the entry task preserves COM7/115200 NSH while the UI runs independently. A UI
+initialization failure never removes the rescue console.
+
+## Modules and Contracts
+
+### Identity
+
+```c
+enum vg_build_mode
+{
+  VG_BUILD_TEST,
+  VG_BUILD_PRODUCTION
+};
+
+struct vg_identity
+{
+  char device_id[40];
+  enum vg_build_mode build_mode;
+  const char *firmware_version;
+};
+
+int vg_identity_init(void);
+const struct vg_identity *vg_identity_get(void);
+```
+
+Test mode validates the compile-time override against `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`.
+Production mode reads the STM32H750 96-bit UID and formats
+`vg-<24 lowercase hex>`. No runtime setter or command exists.
+
+### Startup record
+
+```c
+enum vg_time_quality
+{
+  VG_TIME_UNKNOWN,
+  VG_TIME_RTC,
+  VG_TIME_NTP,
+  VG_TIME_CLOUD
+};
+
+struct vg_startup_state
+{
+  bool directories_ready;
+  bool human_log_written;
+  bool event_written;
+  int storage_error;
+  char boot_id[24];
+  uint64_t ts_ms;
+  uint64_t uptime_ms;
+  enum vg_time_quality time_quality;
+};
+
+int vg_startup_record(void);
+const struct vg_startup_state *vg_startup_get(void);
+```
+
+Startup creates `/data/velaguard`, `configs`, and `logs`, appends a readable
+line to `latest.log`, then appends a JSON object to `events.jsonl`. Each step
+records its own outcome. The boot continues when storage is unavailable, but
+serial and UI state must say `DEGRADED`.
+
+`boot_id` uses 64 random bits from `/dev/urandom` with a monotonic fallback.
+`ts_ms` records `CLOCK_REALTIME`; `time_quality` is `rtc` only when the calendar
+is credible, otherwise `unknown`. `uptime_ms` uses `CLOCK_MONOTONIC`.
+
+### UI
+
+The UI reads immutable identity/startup snapshots. It does not read UID
+registers or perform filesystem I/O. A one-second LVGL timer updates uptime and
+provides a stable debug breakpoint symbol.
+
+## Build Matrix
+
+Product mode and compiler mode are orthogonal:
+
+| Product mode | Compiler mode | Purpose |
+|---|---|---|
+| test | release | normal development run |
+| test | debug | source breakpoint and hardware inspection |
+| production | release | ISSUE1 identity/cold-boot acceptance |
+| production | debug | optional production-path diagnosis |
+
+`windows_build_openvela.ps1` gains a validated VelaGuard mode parameter and
+selects `CONFIG_LVX_USE_VELAGUARD`. It disables the VS Code Lab and stock LVGL
+demo, sets `velaguard_main`, enables required fonts and pseudo-file support,
+and applies the existing QSPI platform configuration. Flash remains owned by
+CubeProgrammer. OpenOCD remains attach-only.
+
+## UI Design
+
+Design Read: a 480x272 industrial device home screen for on-site operators,
+with a trust-first monitoring-console language implemented in native LVGL.
+
+- `DESIGN_VARIANCE: 4`
+- `MOTION_INTENSITY: 2`
+- `VISUAL_DENSITY: 7`
+
+```text
++----------------------------------------------------------+
+| VelaGuard                         TEST      FW 0.1.0      |
++----------------------------------------------------------+
+| LOCAL GATEWAY                                            |
+| vg-test-001                           Storage: READY      |
+| Boot 7F2A91C4                         Uptime 00:00:12      |
++------------------------------------+---------------------+
+| ACQUISITION                        | NETWORK             |
+| Not configured                     | Offline             |
+|                                    +---------------------+
+| ALARM                              | AUDIO               |
+| Not armed                          | Unavailable         |
+|                                    +---------------------+
+|                                    | TIME                |
+|                                    | Unsynced            |
++------------------------------------+---------------------+
+```
+
+Tokens:
+
+| Role | Value |
+|---|---|
+| background | `#0C1218` |
+| surface | `#151E26` |
+| raised surface | `#1C2731` |
+| primary text | `#E7EDF2` |
+| muted text | `#8D9AA5` |
+| product accent | `#39B6B2` |
+| semantic alarm | `#E05B5B` |
+| semantic warning | `#D7A84A` |
+
+All panels use an 8 px radius. Cyan is the only product accent. Red and amber
+appear only for actual semantic states. There are no decorative dots, glows,
+gradients, five equal cards, fake controls, or automatic animation. English
+copy avoids missing glyphs in the enabled Montserrat fonts.
+
+## Error Behavior
+
+| Failure | Serial | UI | Process |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| invalid test Device ID | explicit identity error | `IDENTITY ERROR` | rescue NSH stays available |
+| directory creation fails | path and errno | `Storage: DEGRADED` | UI still starts |
+| readable log fails | file and errno | `Storage: DEGRADED` | JSONL still attempted |
+| JSONL event fails | file and errno | `Storage: DEGRADED` | UI still starts |
+| LVGL display fails | explicit display error | unavailable | UI task exits, NSH remains |
+| touch input fails | touch degradation | non-interactive home still shown | display loop continues |
+
+## Compatibility and Rollback
+
+The VS Code Lab remains in `app/hello_app` as a reference application but is
+disabled in VelaGuard builds. Reverting the VelaGuard app, manifest link, task
+selection, and harness additions restores the current Lab workflow without
+changing the QSPI boot stub or flash addresses.
+
+## Validation
+
+Static checks validate source contracts, UI tokens/copy, manifest linkage,
+PowerShell task selection, JSON files, and prohibited layout patterns. Builds
+validate test and production configuration, required symbols, debug sections,
+and QSPI/internal HEX ranges. Hardware validation covers test-debug display,
+NSH, touch initialization, source attach, production Device ID, and two cold
+boots with an identical production identity.

+# VelaGuard ISSUE1 UI Design
+
+## Design Read
+
+This is a fixed 480x272 industrial device home screen for on-site operators.
+It uses a trust-first monitoring-console language built directly with LVGL.
+It is not a marketing landing page, browser dashboard, or developer console.
+
+- `DESIGN_VARIANCE: 4`
+- `MOTION_INTENSITY: 2`
+- `VISUAL_DENSITY: 7`
+
+## Hierarchy
+
+The screen prioritizes the Local Safety Loop even before later issues make it
+active. Acquisition and Alarm own the larger left region. Network, Audio, and
+Time occupy a narrower supporting region because cloud and media capability
+must not visually outrank local operation.
+
+The identity band keeps Device ID, storage health, boot ID, and uptime visible
+without turning the product surface into a debug terminal. Full logs and
+addresses remain on NSH and in GDB.
+
+## Layout
+
+```text
++----------------------------------------------------------+
+| VelaGuard                         TEST      FW 0.1.0      |
++----------------------------------------------------------+
+| LOCAL GATEWAY                                            |
+| vg-test-001                           Storage: READY      |
+| Boot 7F2A91C4                         Uptime 00:00:12      |
++------------------------------------+---------------------+
+| ACQUISITION                        | NETWORK             |
+| Not configured                     | Offline             |
+|                                    +---------------------+
+| ALARM                              | AUDIO               |
+| Not armed                          | Unavailable         |
+|                                    +---------------------+
+|                                    | TIME                |
+|                                    | Unsynced            |
++------------------------------------+---------------------+
+```
+
+The composition deliberately rejects the historical row of five equal cards.
+That pattern made all subsystems look equally important and reduced readable
+space on the physical display.
+
+## Tokens
+
+| Role | Hex | Use |
+|---|---|---|
+| background | `#0C1218` | screen canvas |
+| surface | `#151E26` | main operational regions |
+| raised surface | `#1C2731` | header and identity band |
+| primary text | `#E7EDF2` | identity and states |
+| muted text | `#8D9AA5` | labels and metadata |
+| accent | `#39B6B2` | VelaGuard brand and selected emphasis |
+| alarm | `#E05B5B` | actual alarm semantics only |
+| warning | `#D7A84A` | degraded/warning semantics only |
+
+All panels use an 8 px radius. There are no shadows, gradients, glows,
+decorative dots, or mixed shape systems.
+
+## Typography and Copy
+
+Use enabled Montserrat sizes with a clear 20/16/12/10 hierarchy. English copy
+is required for ISSUE1 because the current embedded font set lacks Chinese
+glyph coverage.
+
+Placeholder copy must be truthful:
+
+- Acquisition: `Not configured`
+- Alarm: `Not armed`
+- Network: `Offline`
+- Audio: `Unavailable`
+- Time: `Unsynced`
+- Storage: `READY` only after directories and both startup records succeed;
+  otherwise `DEGRADED`
+
+## Interaction and Motion
+
+ISSUE1 has no product action to trigger, so the home screen has no fake buttons
+or navigation. A one-second uptime refresh communicates liveness. No automatic
+decorative animation is allowed. Touch may initialize for platform continuity,
+but it has no ISSUE1 control surface.
+
+## Embedded Taste Pre-flight
+
+- One fixed dark theme and one cyan product accent.
+- Semantic colors only represent real state.
+- No equal five-card row or generic web component pattern.
+- No clipped text, wrapped mode/version label, or hidden Device ID.
+- No decorative dot, pill overlay, glow, gradient, or fake precision.
+- Every visible string is grammatical and maps to an implemented state.
+- Storage degradation remains visible without blocking the rescue console.
+- Physical display contrast and 480x272 edge spacing are readable.
*** End Patch";

关键根因已经用 Windows ARM GCC 复现并验证：

- `-I .../nuttx/include` 会让 Windows 编译器先吃 NuttX 自带 `stdint.h`，随后因 Windows 无法跟随 WSL 的绝对 Linux 软链接 `nuttx/include/arch` 而报 `arch/types.h` 缺失。
- 把 NuttX 通用头目录改为 `-idirafter` 后，同一个 Windows GCC 已经能对 UNC 上的 `velaguard_main.c` 完成 `-fsyntax-only`，退出码为 0。

因此修复会使用真实 Windows ARM GCC、强制加载生成的 `config.h`，并让 NuttX libc 头排在编译器系统头之后；不创建脆弱的假头文件或源码镜像。

- Windows cannot follow Linux absolute symlinks such as:

  - `socklen_t`
  - NuttX/POSIX type conflicts
- Adding forced NuttX `compiler.h`, `sys/types.h`, or `sched.h` caused more libc conflicts.
- Do not continue stacking fake compatibility macros or headers.

trellis:start一般什么时候调用 每个新会话吗？

一般按“每个新会话一次”理解，但你当前 OpenCode 已安装 `session-start` 插件，所以通常会自动执行，不必手工输入。

使用规则：

- 新建 OpenCode 会话：插件会在第一条消息自动注入 Trellis 上下文。
- Codex/OpenCode 相互切换：建议手动执行一次 `/trellis:start`，确认接续状态。
- 切换项目目录或分支：建议重新执行。
- Agent 明显忘记当前任务、Git 状态或项目规范：可以重新执行。
- 恢复一个进行中的任务：优先用 `/trellis:continue`。
- 同一会话内连续交流：不需要重复执行。
- 每条消息都执行：没有必要，会增加上下文噪声。

正常启动后的 Agent 应能报告：

- 当前开发者身份；
- 当前 Git 分支和未提交文件；
- 当前 Trellis task；
- 活跃任务；
- 适用的项目规范。

推荐日常姿势：

```text
打开新的 OpenCode 会话
        ↓
直接描述需求
        ↓
插件自动注入 Trellis 上下文
```

跨 Agent 接续时可以更保险一些：

```text
/trellis:start

先不要修改文件，报告当前分支、Git 状态、当前任务和最近提交。
```

如果当前任务已经创建并进行了一半，则使用：

```text
/trellis:continue
```

一句话总结：新会话自动一次；跨工具或上下文异常时手动 `/trellis:start`；恢复已有任务用 `/trellis:continue`。
我觉得我们当前得讨论一下关于我的RS485在硬件上只能使用USART3而STLINKVCP在硬件上也指向USART3，这可能会影响后续开发，需要解决。

这是必须尽早解决的硬件资源冲突，确实会影响后续开发。

USART3 同时连接 RS485 收发器和 ST-LINK VCP 时，可能产生：

- 调试日志混入 RS485 协议帧；
- ST-LINK VCP 的 TX 与 RS485 收发器同时驱动 MCU RX；
- RS485 接收数据被当成 NSH 命令；
- 半双工方向控制、波特率和串口配置互相冲突；
- 生产环境无法安全保留 USART3 调试控制台。

初步推荐方向是：将 USART3 完整保留给 RS485，把 NSH/日志迁移到其他通道，例如另一组 UART、USB CDC/ACM，或仅调试期使用的其他接口。是否可行需要结合 STM32H750B-DK 原理图、板上跳线/焊桥、你自己的 RS485 接线和当前 NuttX配置确认。

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/tasks/07-13-resolve-usart3-rs485-vcp-conflict/prd.md
*** Add File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/tasks/07-13-resolve-usart3-rs485-vcp-conflict/prd.md
+# Resolve USART3 RS485 and ST-LINK VCP conflict
+
+## Goal
+
+Define and validate a hardware/software ownership model that lets VelaGuard use
+its required RS485/Modbus RTU link without ST-LINK VCP, NSH, low-level console,
+or syslog traffic corrupting the bus or electrically contending with the
+transceiver. Preserve a practical development and recovery channel.
+
+## Background and Confirmed Facts
+
+- VelaGuard requires a real RS485/Modbus RTU acquisition path; the product
+  manual currently illustrates `/dev/ttyS1` but does not bind it to validated
+  board pins.
+- The current release artifact enables `CONFIG_USART3_SERIAL_CONSOLE`,
+  `CONFIG_NSH_CONSOLE`, `CONFIG_ARCH_LOWPUTC`, and default syslog while USART3
+  runs at 115200 8N1. USART3 is therefore not available as an isolated Modbus
+  transport.
+- The STM32H750B-DK board definition selects USART3 on PB10/PB11. Official
+  MB1381 B01 and B04 schematics both connect ST-LINK VCP to target PB10/PB11,
+  confirming that the VCP occupies USART3 electrically.
+- MB1381 revisions differ at the Arduino serial pins: B01 routes D1/D0 through
+  PB10/PB11 (USART3), while B04 routes them through PB6/PG3 (USART1). The actual
+  board revision and RS485 connector/pin path must therefore be identified
+  before choosing a solution.
+- The STM32H7 NuttX serial driver includes `CONFIG_USART3_RS485` and an
+  `GPIO_USART3_RS485_DIR` contract for DE/RE direction. It explicitly rejects
+  RXDMA or TXDMA combined with RS485 on the same USART in the current driver.
+- The currently running ISSUE1 firmware relies on the ST-LINK VCP for startup
+  evidence and rescue NSH. This is a development convenience, not a reason to
+  mix human console traffic with the production field bus.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- Assign exclusive runtime ownership of every electrical UART connection; raw
+  console, NSH, syslog, and RS485 frames must never share USART3 concurrently.
+- Prevent ST-LINK VCP TX and the RS485 receiver output from creating an
+  uncontrolled multi-driver path into the MCU RX pin.
+- Provide deterministic half-duplex RS485 DE/RE control compatible with the
+  actual transceiver module and NuttX serial driver.
+- Retain a documented development/recovery channel after USART3 becomes a
+  field bus, or explicitly define a safe debug-only hardware/configuration
+  mode if no simultaneous channel is feasible.
+- Support normal VelaGuard cold boot, display, touch, storage, QSPI boot, and
+  attach-only SWD debugging without depending on USART3 console output.
+- Base the design on the actual MB1381 revision, connector pins, RS485 module,
+  and wiring rather than generic STM32 alternate-function possibilities.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The actual board revision and RS485 TX/RX/DE/RE electrical path are
+      recorded with connector and MCU pin names.
+- [ ] A schematic-level ownership table identifies USART3, ST-LINK VCP,
+      transceiver inputs/outputs, DE/RE, and any solder bridges or series
+      resistors involved.
+- [ ] The selected design guarantees that console/syslog bytes cannot enter
+      Modbus RTU and that no two active outputs drive PB11 simultaneously.
+- [ ] Development and production console policies are explicit, including how
+      NSH/recovery is accessed when USART3 is reserved for RS485.
+- [ ] NuttX configuration and board-code changes are enumerated with stable
+      device-node expectations that do not rely on accidental `/dev/ttySx`
+      numbering.
+- [ ] Hardware validation covers cold boot, RS485 transmit/receive and DE/RE
+      timing, CRC-clean Modbus transactions, disconnected-device behavior,
+      SWD attach, and the chosen recovery console.
+- [ ] No hardware modification, firmware change, or programming occurs until
+      the written design and implementation plan are reviewed and approved.
+
+## Out of Scope During Planning
+
+- Implementing the Modbus protocol or the full acquisition service.
+- Modifying solder bridges, removing components, or rewiring the board.
+- Changing firmware configuration, building, flashing, or debugging hardware.
+
+## Open Question
+
+- Which MB1381 hardware revision is physically in use, and exactly where are
+  the RS485 module TX, RX, DE, and RE signals connected?
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

你是否要求在 RS485 正常在线收发时，仍然能够通过板载 ST-LINK 使用 SWD 断点调试？

我的推荐是：**要求保留同时 SWD 调试，但放弃板载 VCP 作为 USART3 控制台**。

这样才能在调试 Modbus 收发、异常帧和超时时保持断点能力。对应设计会是：

- 隔离 ST-LINK VCP 对 PB11 的驱动路径，重点处理 `R188`；
- USART3 PB10/PB11 专用于 RS485；
- SWD 的 PA13/PA14/NRST 保持不变；
- NSH/日志迁移到 UART7 + 外部 USB-UART、USB CDC 或 RTT 中的一种；
- 是否保留 `R184` 作为只读 TX 监听，在后续方案比较中决定。

如果你不要求同时 SWD 调试，可以采用不拆元件的互斥模式：运行 RS485 时拔掉 ST-LINK USB并从其他接口供电；需要调试时断开 RS485。但这种方式无法调试真实在线通信故障，我不推荐作为长期开发方案。
按你推荐的来

已记录决策：RS485 在线时必须保留板载 ST-LINK 的 SWD 调试能力；USART3 将专用于 RS485，板载 VCP 不再作为控制台。这个决定意味着仅靠拔线/切换配置不够，必须隔离 `R188` 所在的 VCP TX→PB11 路径。

下一步需要选择新的 NSH/日志通道。我先核对 UART7、USB CDC 和 RTT 在当前板级与 NuttX 中的实际可行性，再给你推荐而不是凭经验选。

三条替代路径的证据已经比较清楚：

- UART7：NuttX STM32H7 驱动和本板 `board.h` 已完整定义，RX=PA8、TX=PB4，分别暴露在 Arduino D5/D10；当前固件未占用。它最适合作为独立、可靠的 NSH恢复口。
- USB CDC：板级有 device 基础钩子，NuttX也支持 CDC NSH，但当前配置是 USB Host、`CONFIG_USBDEV` 未启用；切换会引入 USB角色和启动时序风险。
- RTT：NuttX支持双向 RTT console/syslog，且不占引脚；但它依赖调试器连接，不适合作为独立救援口。

我再确认当前 Windows OpenOCD 是否具备 RTT命令，然后问你是否接受 UART7 外接 USB-TTL。

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/debian19y/openvela/contest2026_004_TeamFalcons/.trellis/tasks/07-13-resolve-usart3-rs485-vcp-conflict/prd.md
@@
 - Product decision: live RS485 traffic must remain debuggable through the
   on-board ST-LINK SWD interface. USART3 will be reserved for RS485 and the
   on-board VCP will no longer serve as its interactive console. The design must
   therefore isolate the VCP TX to PB11 path while leaving SWD intact.
+- UART7 is a ready board-level alternative for an independent console: the
+  STM32H7 driver supports it, `board.h` maps RX to PA8 and TX to PB4, and MB1381
+  B01 exposes those otherwise-unused signals on Arduino D5 and D10. It requires
+  an external 3.3 V USB-to-TTL adapter and three wires but is independent of
+  USB roles and debugger attachment.
+- USB CDC ACM is supported by NuttX and the board has the minimum USB-device
+  suspend hook, but the current product configuration has `CONFIG_USBDEV`
+  disabled and uses the OTG FS board path as a USB host. Making CDC the rescue
+  console would add USB role/configuration and enumeration dependencies.
+- NuttX provides bidirectional SEGGER RTT serial console and syslog backends;
+  the installed xPack OpenOCD exposes RTT server commands. RTT is a useful
+  optional developer log/console path with no extra MCU pins, but it depends on
+  an attached debugger and is not an independent field-recovery channel.
@@
 - Which independent channel should replace USART3 VCP for NSH and diagnostic
   logs during development and recovery?
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

text:
你是否接受增加一个 3.3V USB‑TTL 串口模块，将 UART7 用作新的 NSH/恢复控制台？

推荐接受，接线为：

```text
USB-TTL TX → PA8  / Arduino D5  / UART7_RX
USB-TTL RX → PB4  / Arduino D10 / UART7_TX
USB-TTL GND → 开发板 GND
```

注意必须使用 3.3V 逻辑电平，不连接 USB‑TTL 的 5V/VCC供电脚。

选择 UART7 的优势是：

- USART3 可以完全留给 RS485；
- SWD、RS485和 NSH 可以同时工作；
- 不依赖 USB CDC 枚举；
- 不依赖 OpenOCD/RTT连接；
- 系统启动失败时仍可作为独立救援口；
- NuttX 当前已有 UART7驱动与板级引脚定义，软件改动最小。

代价是需要额外一个 USB‑TTL 模块和三根线。若你不接受额外硬件，我会退而选择 RTT 作为开发控制台，并把 USB CDC作为后续恢复方案，但可靠性和实施复杂度都不如 UART7。
接受
如果这样的话，我的RS485也可以选择更改硬件了，起初我以为只有在ARDUINO CONN上只有UART3的资源，RS485换到UART7会不会是更好的选择？

这个新信息会改变我的推荐：既然 RS485 硬件允许改线，就不必牺牲板载 VCP，也不必拆 `R188/R184`。我会把“UART7 外接 USB‑TTL 已接受”记录为可行备选，但重新比较“USART3=VCP、UART7=RS485”的方案。

先核对 PA8/PB4/候选 DE GPIO 的板级占用、电气属性和 SWD/JTAG影响，再给出明确结论。

text:
是的。既然允许更改 RS485 接线，采用“USART3 保留 ST-LINK VCP，UART7 专用于 RS485”明显更好。

推荐资源分配：

```text
USART3 PB10/PB11
└── 保留板载 ST-LINK VCP
    ├── COM7
    ├── NSH
    └── 启动日志

UART7
├── TX：PB4 / Arduino D10 → RS485 DI
├── RX：PA8 / Arduino D5 ← RS485 RO
└── DIR：PK1 / Arduino D4 → RS485 DE + /RE
```

优势：

- 不需要拆除 `R188/R184`；
- 当前 COM7、NSH 和启动日志保持不变；
- RS485 与调试控制台完全独立；
- RS485、串口日志和 SWD断点可以同时工作；
- PA8、PB4、PK1 当前未被 VelaGuard占用；
- PB4 虽然复用 NJTRST，但当前使用 SWD而非完整 JTAG，不受影响；
- UART7 启用后预计成为 `/dev/ttyS1`，与项目手册现有描述一致。

如果硬件也可以优化，我不建议继续使用自动方向 MAX485ESA作为最终方案。更推荐：

- 使用 3.3V RS485收发器，例如 MAX3485、SP3485或同类器件；
- 将 `DE` 与低有效 `/RE` 连接在一起；
- 接到 PK1/Arduino D4；
- 启用 NuttX `CONFIG_UART7_RS485`；
- 由串口驱动在发送开始和发送完成时切换方向；
- 暂不启用 UART7 RX/TX DMA，因为当前 STM32H7驱动明确禁止 DMA 与 RS485方向控制同时使用。

相比自动收发，这种方式的 Modbus RTU收发切换时序更确定，也更容易测试和排查丢首字节、截断尾字节等问题。

下一项需要你决定：是否接受将当前自动收发 MAX485ESA模块替换或改造为“3.3V收发器 + PK1控制 DE/RE”？我的推荐是接受。
接受

已记录最终硬件方向：USART3继续承担板载 VCP；UART7承担 RS485；换用 3.3V收发器，并由 PK1/D4控制 DE与 `/RE`。这撤销了拆 R188/R184 和 UART7外接控制台的早期分支。

下一步我会从现有产品手册中提取 Modbus串口参数、设备节点和验收要求；仓库已有答案的部分不再问你，只确认尚未定义的现场设备约束。

1. 开发板侧 RS485模块

```text
工作电压：3.3V
```

接线规划：

```text
PB4 / D10 / UART7_TX → DI

PK1 / D4             → DE 与 /RE 并联
3V3                   → VCC
```

2. PC侧 USB‑RS485转换器
